thread:
Evan T.: noticed an uptick in websocket reconnect churn after today's routing tweak. Console shows many 'idle timeout' events but packet captures show proxy sending FIN first.
Sara M.: yep, likely misaligned timers. The client heartbeat is 30s, proxy idle is 20s under mem-pressure GC.
Dilip (SRE): px-09 logs show 'prune_idle' at 10:11:03Z. Server last write at 10:10:55Z.
Evan T.: this pattern causes immediate reconnects and repeated auth calls; billing dashboard shows small but measurable token count bump.
Sara M.: short-term mitigation: can we increase proxy idle threshold for edge-b to 40s until we roll the proxy patch?
infra-bot: scheduled config change: proxy_idle_threshold=40s for edge-b; rolling to 2/3 nodes now.
Dilip (SRE): note: we also need better telemetry. console currently marks disconnect_reason=client_only if client closed; no field for proxy_initiated.
Evan T.: proposal: emit labels close_initiator (client|proxy|server) and edge_id from edge agent on close. Gate for private installs.
Sara M.: agree. For UX, add a 'likely cause' tag when close_initiator=proxy in >25% of disconnects in 5m. That reduces ops noise.
Dilip (SRE): caution: do not expose edge_id to customer-facing events in private without redaction opt-in. We'll add tenant-policy gating.
Evan T.: I'll push tiny canary that adds close_initiator tag to internal events only.
infra-bot: canary deploy 7412345678-close-initiator -> edge-b (3%) succeeded.
Evan T.: canary shows close_initiator=proxy on most suspicious restarts. console-bot: updating dashboard to display 'Proxy-initiated disconnect (likely)' banner for affected routes.
console-bot: dashboard note added for route=beta: Banner "Likely proxy-initiated idle disconnects" when proxy closes >25% in 5m.
Sara M.: sounds good. Follow-up: add alert rule if reconnects >150/min and proxy-initiated ratio >30% to page SRE.
Dilip (SRE): ticket created INF-2026 to track agent header emission and retention. Link: https://internal/redwood/INF-2026
Evan T.: great. Will monitor telemetry tonight.
Sara M.: thanks team, keep customer comms ready if billing anomalies confirmed. :thumbsup:
